d: On one side, and in a part of the bottom, the théâtre represents a mountain full of rocks and bushy trees. A cave appears at the foot; there comes out a spring that falls quickly. On the rump of the mountain, in the bottom, rises a temple whose door is open, and where one sees a lamp burned. A staircase leads to this temple, and to the right a crooked and steeped path, leads from the temple to the top of the mountain. On the other side, rises a wing of the palace of Creon, gardens and buildings. The sky is very dark; one hears the thunder; the theater receives light only that of the lightnings which shine at intervals. After a sound of thunder, one sees Neris coming out from the side of the king with the two sons of Medea; they wear the crown and the robe intended for Dircé. When they are in front of the temple, they stop and greet each other; they then pass in silence at the palace, where they enter. The storm continues, and after a few times one slowly sees Memens coming down.
The Theatre represents a gallery of the Palace of Creon
Medea, Neri, the two sons of Medea

Creon, Dirce, Jason, Women of Dirce, troupe of the Argonauts, Corrinthian women, Soldiers, People of Corinth. Creon and Dirce placed themselves on a throne; all the troupe passes before them, and carries in triumph the golden fleece, and an image of the Argo ship.
Previous ones, Medea covered with a long veil.
Medea, Jason, Creon, Dirced, supported by his wives.

The Theatre represents, on one side, a wing of the Palace of Creon; one descends from it by a large staircase. At the end of this wing, an elegant and vast portico leads to the temple of Junon, which is located opposite, placed obliquely, so that the door and facade of this temple are in sight of the spectator.

Medea, after her imprecation, fell on the staircase of the palis; she seems absorbed in a deep and sinister dream. Neri approached it timidly, yet at a certain distance; and dared not interrupt the fierce silence of her mistress, she seems to say to herself.
Medea, Jason, Neri (she retreats to the bottom).

Medea, Neris knew the front of the scene; Creon, Jason, Dircée, Priests, soldiers, Women, People in the background. We see under the Creon portal, Jason, Dircée and all the procession. They enter the temple; part of the people remain in front of the door; we hear their cans, and we see their sacrifice.
